name: v2ecoli-real-data
title: Real-Data Validation — Loading and Classifying v2ecoli Zarr Stores
question: Can the ZarrMultiOmicLoader correctly extract features from real v2ecoli zarr stores, and can the GenotypeToPhenotypeProcess classify phenotypes from this biologically realistic data?
objective:
Run a v2ecoli simulation with XArrayEmitter, load the zarr output with
ZarrMultiOmicLoader, map observables to modality slots, and train the
quantum classifier on real simulated multi-omic data.
hypothesis: The ZarrMultiOmicLoader will correctly handle real v2ecoli zarr structure. The quantum classifier will achieve non-trivial accuracy (>0.65 AUC-ROC).

study_card.goal: Validate the end-to-end pipeline on real v2ecoli simulation data.
study_card.mechanism: Run a v2ecoli simulation with XArrayEmitter, load with ZarrMultiOmicLoader, train the GenotypeToPhenotypeProcess. Tests both the data loader's correctness on real zarr structure and the classifier's ability to extract signal from biologically realistic data.
study_card.why_before_next: Synthetic validation is necessary but not sufficient — real biological data has different structure and noise.
study_card.expected_result: Loader correctly extracts 3+ modalities; classifier AUC-ROC > 0.65.

description: This study closes the loop from v2ecoli simulation to zarr store to ZarrMultiOmicLoader to GenotypeToPhenotypeProcess. It validates the loader handles real v2ecoli zarr structure (hive partitions, generation arrays, vector observables), the default modality map maps real observables correctly, and the quantum classifier can learn from biologically realistic data. Requires a v2ecoli simulation run with XArrayEmitter producing a zarr store.
expected_behavior: ZarrMultiOmicLoader returns non-None for at least 3 modality paths from a real v2ecoli zarr store.
GenotypeToPhenotypeProcess achieves AUC-ROC > 0.65 on features extracted from real v2ecoli data.
